_doc: Report rules that publish-run.sh enforces (audit.sh reports them as warnings). page_forbidden: refused anywhere in the page. finding_forbidden: refused only in finding text (titles, walk-through steps, detail), so a page table that shows a title's length is fine. Case-insensitive Python regexes. Add a test in tests/test_publish_gate.py for every new rule.

page_forbidden.why: Policy: a pre-consent / CIPA tracker finding is a legal opinion, not an SEO finding; it never appears in a published page.
page_forbidden.re: before visitors can consent|pre-consent|\bCIPA\b|consent banner actually blocks

finding_forbidden.why: Policy: no title or meta description LENGTH findings (no 60/160-character limits); Google rewrites snippets and length is not a defect.
finding_forbidden.re: \b(titles?|meta descriptions?|descriptions?)\b[^.]{0,60}\b(too long|too short|longer than|shorter than|exceeds?|over|under)\b[^.]{0,20}\d+\s*(characters|chars)|\b\d+\s*(characters|chars)\b[^.]{0,40}\b(limit|too long|too short|truncat\w*|cut off)

finding_forbidden.why: Owner: a site's own aggregateRating markup is never a finding.
finding_forbidden.re: publishes its own star rating|gives itself (a )?(star|stars)|self-(authored|given|published) (star )?rating|aggregateRating block
